fontFamily.$description: D-005 — single geometric-sans family for both heading and body (Braun ref hierarchy comes from position/size of blocks, not font), + separate mono for code.

fontWeight.$description: Standard weight scale — D-005 doesn't restrict weights, only family/ratio.

fontSize.$description: D-005 — base 16px, ratio 1.2 (Minor Third), flattest standard ratio to avoid font-driven hierarchy per D-001.

lineHeight.$description: D-005 — body 1.5 (relaxed reading), heading 1.15 (tighter, larger sizes).

letterSpacing.$description: No decision restricts letter-spacing — standard defaults (blueprint checklist default).
